content_zh:
没有武器, 没有粮草, 没有支援。他们要怎么渡过这个冬天？要怎么淌过最冷的冰河, 回到故土的家乡？她还有多少兄弟？他们的将士作战逃亡只能用腿, 而对方却骑着自己朝廷赔出去的良驹, 究竟能不能逃过敌军的围捕……
紧密而来的马蹄声，通过土壤传入她的耳际。伴随着心跳越发急促、清晰，像擂鼓般阵阵敲响, 即将刺破她的耳膜。
“跑——！”
一句话尚未吼出喉咙，连胜倏然睁开眼。
入目是透明的窗台，明媚的阳光正照在她的手上。
身下不是泥泞的土地, 枕着的也不是冰冷的刀剑。连胜一瞬间有些恍惚。
来到这里已经有段时间, 她还是不停回忆起自己的过去。
一面是铁马冰河的人间战场，一面是安稳平静的未来社会。她不知道跨越了多少年, 来到了这个地方。而这个地方太过陌生, 她始终融入不了, 只是在扮演自己的角色。
连胜摸着自己的脖子, 略微失神地看着窗外的景色, 外面响起三下有节奏的敲门声。
一女声喊说：“快起床了, 知道现在是什么时候了吗？”
连胜看了眼床头的光脑，抬手擦干冷汗，用力揉了把脸, 才掀开被子起身。
现在是联盟新历335年。马上就要举行联盟大学军事学院的实战演习, 所有学院学生每学期强制参加。
包括她——大三军事指挥系的新转系生。
连胜拖拉地从楼梯上下来，整个人透出一股萎靡不振的气息。
太松懈了……这样的日子她实在是很不习惯。
连胜的母亲——林冽，一位长发的干练女人，正坐在餐桌前，翘着一只脚，带着一丝不满道：“如果你不喜欢军事学院，那就重新申请转学院吧。指挥系不是一个可以给你混日子的专业。”
连胜偏头看了眼墙上挂着的照片。里面两人身穿军服，胸佩勋章，一脸张扬。再看自己，浑身瘦弱，手臂毫无力量，一看就知道缺乏锻炼。
不禁撇撇嘴，真是让他们失望了。
连胜也在餐桌旁边坐下，拉伸了一下手臂，简略答道：“不。军事挺好。”
林冽看了她一眼，没有继续说话。

她们一天加起来的话，也不会超过三句。今天早上的已经达标了。
林冽抓起椅子上的衣服，套在外面，又抓过桌上的钥匙，不带任何感情的说道：“拿起你的早餐，我先送你去营地，然后我要回研究院了。”
连胜停下四处窥觑的眼睛，顺了桌上的面包，跟在她身后出门。
一言不发地走进飞行器，系上安全带，然后等待起飞。
连胜闭上眼适应了一下。
如果大梁也有这边的技术……不，只要有一架这个东西，她就可以直接撞出一座城来。
连胜想到这个，不禁眼神一黯。
忽然间来到这里，不知道那边的自己又怎么样了。
窗外景色晃眼而过。连胜还在平复心情，飞行器就已经到了地方。
联盟大学的实战演习并不在学校举行，而是校方租用的一座山林。
根据连胜查到的资料，这座森林最大程度地保持了原始的地形和外貌。听起来非常适合连胜，她很满意。
林冽将她在营地放下后就直接离开了，留下连胜一个人在这边处理。
连胜对学校的人不熟，学校的人对她也不熟，因为她是今年新转系的学生。只是她的存在太过特别，所以走到哪里，都有几道视线盯着她。
好在这边的文字与她过去用的非常相似，她对着网上的字库学习了一遍之后，能认得九成。
照着营地标注的指示，过去物资点领了帐篷和地图，然后艰难将东西拖回各系划定好的区域。
那些装备物资挺沉的，或许说是连胜太缺乏锻炼了。她一路拖过了三个聚集的营地，也没见一个人过来帮她。
指挥系的一片人住在临河的空地。
连胜放下东西，去河边考察了一下，然后选择了地势较高，位置偏远的地方扎营。
作战的时候，要驻扎在远水，居高，向阳之地。这是时刻的警惕。虽说这边没有什么敌人来犯，但要是下个雨，半夜涨水，下面的人多半得给淹了。
位置选定后如果要移动她觉得相当麻烦，还要争抢，谁也说不定什么时候会下雨，不如干脆找个安全点的位置。

content_en:
No weapons, no food, no support. How are they going to survive this winter? How to cross the coldest glacier and return to your hometown? How many brothers does she have? Their soldiers can only use their legs to fight and escape, but the opponent is riding a good horse that was given away by the court. Can they escape the enemy's roundup...
The sound of horses' hooves came through the soil and reached her ears. As her heartbeat became faster and clearer, it was beating like a drum, about to pierce her eardrums.
"Run—!"
Before a word could be shouted out of his throat, Lian Sheng suddenly opened his eyes.
What she saw was a transparent window sill, and the bright sunlight was shining on her hands.
There is no muddy earth beneath him, nor is the cold sword lying on his pillow. Streak was a little dazed for a moment.
It's been a while since she came here, and she still keeps recalling her past.
On one side is the human battlefield of Iron Horse Glacier, and on the other side is the stable and peaceful future society. She didn't know how many years passed before she came to this place. And this place was so unfamiliar that she could never integrate into it, she was just playing her own role.
Lian Sheng touched his neck and looked at the scenery outside the window slightly absentmindedly. There were three rhythmic knocks on the door outside.
A female voice shouted: "Get up soon, do you know what time it is now?"
Lian Sheng glanced at Guang Nao on the bedside, raised his hand to wipe away the cold sweat, rubbed his face vigorously, then lifted the quilt and stood up.
It is now the 335th year of the Alliance's new calendar. A practical exercise of the Alliance University Military Academy will be held soon, and it is compulsory for all academy students to participate every semester.
Including her, a new transfer student from the military command department in her junior year.
Lian Sheng shuffled down the stairs, his whole person exuding an aura of malaise.
Too lax... She was really not used to living like this.
Lian Sheng's mother, Lin Lie, a long-haired and capable woman, was sitting at the dining table with one foot raised and said with a hint of dissatisfaction: "If you don't like the military academy, then reapply to transfer to the academy. The command department is not a major that can give you a job."
Lian Sheng tilted his head and glanced at the photos hanging on the wall. The two people inside were wearing military uniforms, with medals on their chests, and they looked flamboyant. Looking at myself again, I see that my body is thin and my arms have no strength. I can tell at a glance that I lack exercise.
I couldn't help but curl my lips, I really let them down.
Lian Sheng also sat down at the dining table, stretched his arms, and simply replied: "No. The military is pretty good."
Lin Lie glanced at her and did not continue speaking.
Their combined words in a day would not exceed three sentences. This morning's was up to par.
Lin Lie grabbed the clothes on the chair, put them on, then grabbed the keys on the table, and said without any emotion: "Pick up your breakfast, I will send you to the camp first, and then I will go back to the institute."
Lian Sheng stopped looking around, took the bread on the table, and followed her out.
Wordlessly, he stepped into the aircraft, fastened his seatbelt, and waited for takeoff.
Lian Sheng closed his eyes and adjusted.
If Daliang also has the technology here... No, as long as she has one of these things, she can directly crash out of a city.
Thinking of this, Lian Sheng couldn't help but darken his eyes.
Suddenly I came here and I didn’t know what was going on with me over there.
The scenery outside the window was dazzling. While Lian Sheng was still calming down, the aircraft had already arrived.
The actual combat exercises of Alliance University are not held in the school, but in a mountain forest rented by the school.
According to the information obtained by Lian Sheng, this forest has maintained its original topography and appearance to the greatest extent. It sounded perfect for a winning streak, and she was pleased with it.
Lin Lie dropped her off at the camp and left directly, leaving Lian Sheng to handle it alone.
Lian Sheng is not familiar with the people at the school, and the people at the school are not familiar with her either, because she is a new student who transferred to the department this year. It’s just that her existence is too special, so wherever she goes, there were several eyes staring at her.
Fortunately, the words here were very similar to those she had used in the past. After studying the fonts on the Internet, she could recognize 90% of them.
Following the instructions marked on the campground, we went to the material point to pick up tents and maps, and then dragged the things back to the areas designated by each department with difficulty.
The equipment and materials are quite heavy, perhaps because the winning streak lacks training. She dragged her through three gathering camps and saw no one coming to help her.
A group of people from the command system lived in an open space near the river.
Lian Sheng put down his things, went to the river to investigate, and then chose a higher and remote place to camp.
When fighting, be stationed far from water, on high ground, and in a sunny place. This is constant vigilance. Although there are no enemies here, if it rains and the water rises in the middle of the night, most of the people below will be drowned.
She found it quite troublesome to move after the location was selected, and she had to fight for it. No one could tell when it would rain, so it was better to find a safer location.
